title: Pipeline change impact + staged migration
description: Trace impact branches, preserve failed checks, and continue in a declared degraded mode when checks are exhausted.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: pipeline-change-impact-staged-migration
  title: Pipeline change impact + staged migration
  description: Trace independent impact branches, preserve failed checks, and continue in a declared degraded mode when bounded migration is exhausted.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce an evidence-backed staged migration with explicit unavailable branches and rollback ownership.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 4, onFailure: preserve-completed, requireApprovalFor: [migration-approval] }
  nodes:
    - id: change
      kind: input
      name: Proposed pipeline change
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties: { text: { type: string } }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: upstream
      kind: agent
      name: Trace upstream impact
      templateRef: data-04
      role: Lineage analyst who maps upstream and downstream change impact.
      prompt: Trace the supplied asset through sources, transformations, schedules, owners, consumers, and controls. List unavailable branches explicitly and rank migration risk by evidence.
      capabilities:
        skills: [data-lineage-analysis, change-impact-analysis]
        tools: [read, search]
        connectors: [mcp:postgres, mcp:github]
        permissions: [read-only]
        customizations:
          data-lineage-analysis:
            template: data-lineage-analysis
            instructions: Preserve inaccessible lineage branches as explicit failed checks rather than dropping them.
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: downstream
      kind: agent
      name: Trace downstream consumers
      templateRef: data-04
      role: Lineage analyst who maps upstream and downstream change impact.
      prompt: Trace the supplied asset through sources, transformations, schedules, owners, consumers, and controls. List unavailable branches explicitly and rank migration risk by evidence.
      capabilities: { skills: [data-lineage-analysis, change-impact-analysis], tools: [read, search], connectors: [mcp:postgres, mcp:github], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: impact-fan-in
      kind: join
      name: Preserve successful and failed impact checks
      config: { join: allSettled }
    - id: migration-loop
      kind: loop
      name: Run bounded staged migration checks
      config: { body: [upstream, downstream, impact-fan-in], exitCondition: migration_checks.passed == true, maxIterations: 3, onExhausted: continue }
    - id: migration-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Data owner accepts full or degraded migration plan
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Approved staged migration and unavailable-check register
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: change, to: upstream, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: change, to: downstream, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: upstream, to: impact-fan-in, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: downstream, to: impact-fan-in, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: impact-fan-in, to: migration-loop, kind: dependency }
    - { id: e6, from: migration-loop, to: migration-approval, kind: control, condition: loop_exhausted }
    - { id: e7, from: impact-fan-in, to: migration-approval, kind: control, condition: checks_passed }
    - { id: e8, from: migration-approval, to: result, kind: dependency, condition: approved }
